title: Software to AXI4-Stream
text: Stream AXI4 data from software to FPGA, 2 inputs, 4 outputs, {Sample time} sets Time interval of sampling; {Memory simulation} sets the simulation timing accuracy, {Memory selection} sets the between memory regions, {Region size (bytes)} sets the size of the allocated memory region, in bytes Read-only, {Number of buffers}, {Burst length}, {FIFO depth (number of bursts)} sets the depth of FIFO for data, {FIFO almost full depth (number of bursts)} sets the depth of FIFO when backpressure, {Clock frequency (MHz)} sets the interconnect frequency of manager datapath, {Data width (bits)} sets the data width of manager datapath, {Dimensions}, {Data type}, {Enable sample packing (last signal dimension as channel)} sets the pack data on last dimension of signal and {View performance plots} displays performance metrics. Values come from the instance.
